provenance.notes: video-derived via MediaPipe fallback + GMR (no SMPL-X); quality pass; slight backward torso lean; v2 = en_garde_v1 with the front (right) foot turned down the fencing line by fixes.set_foot_heading (leg IK, sole held in place; turn 48 deg, IK error 0.02 mm). v1's front foot pointed 47 deg off the line, its right hip yaw was -0.77 rad / hip roll -0.37, and the COM sat 1.8 cm outside the support polygon, so it could not be held statically; v2: hip yaw -0.03, hip roll +0.04, COM 0.9 cm inside. Every v1-based policy carried a ~0.28 rad right hip yaw / 0.25 rad ankle roll offset (cut_head_v2_tip failed the joint gate on it).; v3 = en_garde_v2 with the end hold lengthened from 0.5 s to 2.0 s. mjlab resamples an env when its motion ends, so a policy only learns to stand as long as the reference's end hold, while the eval holds the last frame 2 s: en_garde_v2_pipe tracked better than v1 (joint 0.077 vs 0.089) but drifted ~6 cm by the motion's end and fell 1.3 s into the hold (recovery 0.07); advance_lunge_v3 (2 s end hold) took recovery from 0.00 to 1.00.
